name: Handmade Hibiscus & Flower Herbal Powder
shortDescription: Pure botanical powder handcrafted with dried Hibiscus, Rose & natural herbs.
fullDescription: Traditionally prepared personal-care powder crafted using sun-dried Hibiscus flowers, Rose petals, Amla, and selected botanical herbs. Designed as a gentle, natural addition to your daily skin and hair wellness routines.
ingredients: Sun-Dried Red Hibiscus Flower Petals (Hibiscus rosa-sinensis)
usageInstructions: Mix 1-2 teaspoons of powder with plain water, rose water, or curd to form a smooth paste. Apply gently on skin or scalp, leave for 10-15 minutes, and rinse thoroughly with clean water.
precautions: For external personal-care use only. Perform a small skin patch test behind the ear 24 hours before full application. Discontinue use if irritation occurs.

name: Handmade Floral Body Wash Powder
shortDescription: Traditional herbal bath powder with Vetiver, Hibiscus & Sandalwood.
fullDescription: An authentic chemical-free bath cleanser (Snana Chooranam) handcrafted with soothing Vetiver roots, Hibiscus petals, Green gram, and real Sandalwood. Leaves skin feeling naturally refreshed and subtly scented.
usageInstructions: Mix with water during bath and gently scrub over body as a natural soap replacement.
precautions: Keep pouch dry and sealed. For external application only.
